digest.component_or_area: link subsystem / rebar.link() facade / MCP tool
propositions: A cross-subtree blocking link escalates endpoints silently to callers (library and MCP) because the redirect record is printed to stdout only, which is captured and discarded by the quiet sink.

The redirect record is never returned as a value; it flows through five layers (add_dependency -> link_core -> _link closure -> _python_leaf -> rebar.link) and three of them discard it without returning.
MCP tool link_tickets returns literal "ok" regardless of whether endpoints were escalated, leaving agents unaware that a different edge than requested was recorded.
The quiet sink must remain to protect MCP-over-stdio protocol integrity and in-process callers (reconciler inbound apply, code-review finalizer, review-bot voter) from stray stdout.
Library and MCP callers need the redirect record as a return value to be aware of escalation, while the CLI continues receiving it via stdout print.
The fix propagates the redirect record through all five layers as return values while leaving quiet=True and stdout print unchanged.
